verdict: Instagram lead ads are generating leads at roughly $145 each — near the high end of industry norms.
diagnosis: You spent $7,835 for 54 leads this period, a $145 cost per lead, while Google Business Profile quietly delivered 71 phone calls for free.

signals.headline: 54 paid leads at $145 each
signals.detail: Instagram Instant Form drove 54 leads on $7,835 spend. That is inside HVAC norms but not cheap.

signals.headline: 71 phone calls from Google listing
signals.detail: Your Google Business Profile produced 71 direct call clicks and 96 direction requests — free, high-intent demand.

signals.headline: 12 new five-star reviews landed
signals.detail: You added 12 reviews this period at a perfect 5.0 average. Reputation is compounding faster than paid results.

signals.headline: Only 1,886 clicks from 200,666 views
signals.detail: Ad views are strong but click-through is under 1%. Creative or offer is not pulling scrollers to act.

signals.headline: Zero tracked purchases from ads
signals.detail: Return on ad spend registers as zero. Either sales are not tracked back to Instagram, or leads are not closing.

benchmark.label: Benchmark
benchmark.subheader: $145 sits at the high end of HVAC norms
benchmark.body: HVAC blended cost per lead averages $104 on Google Ads in 2026, with non-branded search around $149 and Local Services Ads at $51–$95. Your $145 Instagram lead cost is competitive but not efficient.

seasonal.label: Seasonal
seasonal.body: Late summer is the highest call-volume window for HVAC. Organic demand is high, so paid ad spend often gets diluted. Shifting budget toward fall tune-up promotions ahead of demand pulls in shoulder-season revenue.

competitor.label: Competitor
competitor.body: Only 11% of HVAC businesses reply to leads within an hour. Phone leads close at roughly 46% versus 7.8% for web forms, so fast callbacks beat cheaper leads every time.

recommendations.title: Test Google Local Services Ads alongside Instagram
recommendations.detail: Local Services Ads average $51–$95 per HVAC lead versus your $145. Worth running a small test budget to compare booked-job cost head to head.

recommendations.title: Time every new lead's first callback
recommendations.detail: Phone leads close near 46% when answered fast. Consider tracking response time on the 54 leads you paid for and tightening callback speed.

recommendations.title: Shift some August spend to fall tune-up offers
recommendations.detail: Cooling demand is already organic this month. Test moving part of budget toward pre-season furnace tune-up ads to fill September and October.
